query:
-- Get project and tag IDs, then link them
INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id
FROM projects p
CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.slug = 'alls-well-that-ends-well'
AND t.slug IN ('shakespeare', 'operatic-design', 'curtain-architecture', 'theatre-festival', '2025')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE projectId=VALUES(projectId);
